content: अर्द् €1 <ab>P.</ab> [अर्दति, आनर्द, आर्दीत्, अर्दितुम्, अर्दित or अर्ण] .²1 To afflict, torment; strike, hurt, kill; रक्षःसहस्राणि चतुर्दशादीत् <ls>Bk. 12. 56</ls>, see {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} below. .²2 To beg, request, ask; निर्गलिताम्बुगर्भं शरद्घनं नार्दति चातकोऽपि <ls>R. 5. 17</ls>. .²3 To go, to move, be agitated or moved; be scattered (as dust); आर्दन् धन्वानि सरयन्त आपः <ls>Rv. 4. 17. 2</ls>; fly in pieces, dissolve; श्लोणया काटमर्दति <ls>Av. 12. 4. 3</ls>. (The past participle is usually अर्दित, but अर्ण when the root is preceded by अभि, नि, वि, सम्; <ab>cf.</ab> अर्देः संनिविभ्यः अभेश्चाविदूर्ये <ls>P. VII. 2. 24-5</ls>). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} or €10 <ab>P.</ab> .²1 .³({%a%}) To afflict, torment, distress; तत एनं महावेगैरर्दयामास तोमरैः <ls>Mb.</ls>; कामार्दित, कोप˚, भय˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%b%}) To strike, hurt, injure, kill; येनार्दिदत् दैत्यपुरं पिनाकी <ls>Bk. 2. 42</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">9. 19</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 90</ls>. .²2 To stir up, rouse, agitate, shake vehemently, make agitated or restless; अभि क्रन्द स्तनयार्दयोदधिम् <ls>Av. 4. 15. 6</ls>. .²3 To distort; अर्दयित्वानिलो वक्त्रमर्दितं जनयत्यतः <ls>Suśr.</ls> With {@अति@} to torment excessively, fall upon or attack; अत्यार्दीत् वालिनः पुत्रम् (<ab>v. l.</ab> अभ्यार्दीत्) <ls>Bk. 15. 115</ls>. .{@-अभि@} to distress, afflict, pain, oppress; अभ्यर्दितो वृषलः (शीतेन पीडितः) <ls>P. VII. 2. 25. Sk.</ls> .{@-नि@} <ab>Ved.</ab> to stream forth, flow out. .{@-प्र@} to overwork, to work or exert oneself beyond measure; to cause to flow away. .{@-प्रति@} to oppress or press hard in return, assail in return, return an attack. .{@-वि@} <ab>Ved.</ab> to go or move away; to oppress, harass, pain. --{%<ab>caus.</ab>%} to cause to be scattered or dissolved, destroy, annihilate. .{@-सम्@} {%<ab>caus.</ab>%} to pain greatly, wound, distress.
